$comment: Every VS Code internal DOM hook the layer depends on. Internal = not an API, may change between editor releases. When `npm run check` fails after an update, fix names here (the mobilize-editor skill does this).

partTitles.$comment: The title strip of a part; the layer lays its own view bar exactly over it.

partTitleLabels.$comment: The name of what a part shows (the active agent in the secondary side bar); shown in the layer's view bar.

partTitleActions.$comment: The view's own title buttons (an agent's new chat, history, settings); the view bar leaves them uncovered.

check.$comment: Only used by the automated check to confirm each tab shows the right view.
